title: Recently opened items
whyItMatters: Shared File Lists record recently opened documents, applications and network servers. They show what the user worked on and where they connected.
source: macOS artifact cheat sheet: ~/Library/Application Support/com.apple.sharedfilelist holds .sfl2/.sfl3 recent item lists - https://www.macforensics.app/en/artifacts/cheat-sheet
notes: Full Disk Access may be needed on a live system. The .sfl files are counted, never parsed; encoded bookmark paths are not decoded.
